title: Malicious code in prefix-script-engine-batch (npm)
description: The npm package 'prefix-script-engine-batch' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected system should be rotated immediately from a different, secure computer. Removal of the package alone may not eliminate all malicious software, as the attacker may have established persistent control over the system.
